definitions.explanation: The person who presides over a meeting or assembly.
The presiding officer of a legislative body.

examples.japanese: {議長|ぎちょう}が{会議|かいぎ}を{進行|しんこう}する。
{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}{議長|ぎちょう}
examples.english: Speaker of the House of Representatives.

examples.japanese: {議長|ぎちょう}に{選|えら}ばれた。

notes:
{議長|ぎちょう} presides over meetings or assemblies.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {会議|かいぎ}の{議長|ぎちょう} (meeting chairman)
- {国会|こっかい}{議長|ぎちょう} (Diet speaker)
- {衆議院|しゅうぎいん}{議長|ぎちょう} (House of Representatives speaker)
- {参議院|さんぎいん}{議長|ぎちょう} (House of Councillors speaker)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {議長|ぎちょう}を{務|つと}める (to serve as chairman)
- {議長|ぎちょう}に{選出|せんしゅつ}される (to be elected chairman)
- {議長|ぎちょう}が{指名|しめい}する (the chairman designates)
